purpose: Canonical fixture paths, acceptance commands, expected exit codes, observed results, and invariants for the desktop v0.x release gates.

checks.note: Use the isolated CI harness; this can start Rails on port 3000 and must not run against the user's occupied development endpoint.
Current generated fixtures are WebDriver test bundles and do not establish production Stable DMG or Arch package acceptance.

package_pair_generator.limitation: Current generator creates test-only WebDriver bundles (AppImage on Linux); it is not proof of the supported Stable DMG or Arch package transition. Replace/extend it for packaged Stable N-1 to N tests.

invariants: Create, edit, save, close, and reopen without source loss.
Source round-trips byte-for-byte, including front matter and [[...]] syntax.
Create, edit, save, close, reopen, and present.
Source round-trips byte-for-byte, including ordinary Markdown and literal document-link syntax.
Preview and presentation retain theme, typography, math, Mermaid, Art, and local media.
Export/import preserves source and media bytes.
A pre-manifest deck with a noncanonical top-level Markdown filename opens.
Compatible open/save/export/import preserves the exact Markdown bytes.
Stable does not activate excluded document linking for [[...]].
Unsupported directive text survives compatible save and .elef round-trip byte-for-byte.
Stable starts with app-data/library-root.json pointing at the fixture library.
The original selected path and deck identity remain unchanged after upgrade and relaunch.
Stale save does not overwrite external bytes.
Local unsaved text remains available while conflict resolution is pending.
Unsafe close/update leaves the app open.
Install N-1, stage N, restart, and prove the installed app is N.
Library and source survive; unsafe save, interrupted install, invalid signature, and blocked eligibility defer or fail safely.
No sentinel value appears in default logs or exported diagnostics ZIP, including failures and arbitrary exception inputs.

environment_notes: The full E2E command uses disposable fixtures, but can start a Rails test server on port 3000; do not run it while the user's development server occupies that port.
An expected exit code is not a result. Null observed exit codes and TODO statuses mean the acceptance scenario has not yet been run and passed.
